statement: PDF extraction and rendering were executed locally while the parent reported candidate07 sequence03 active. timing_interpretation: The UTC values are observed filesystem mtime/ctime metadata read after the work. Birth times are unavailable. They identify output writes, not certified process start/end, an execution envelope, CPU time, or proof of core separation. Tool-reported wall values are likewise not measurements of impact on the active numerical run.
resource_consequence: Local CPU, memory and filesystem activity occurred during an active local sequence. Possible timing interference must remain disclosed. Its magnitude is unmeasured; this record neither asserts harmlessness nor attributes any numerical failure to it.
